answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission. Each submission hangs on the harbor of a task receipt, and the ocean is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the canyon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
